extensionName.description: The add-on name shown in Thunderbird.

extensionDescription.message: A local-first, learning mail assistant for Thunderbird. Triages your inbox, explains every call and learns your corrections as on-device rules, drafts review-required replies, tracks follow-ups and reminders, and keeps all data on your machine with one-click export and delete.

panelReading.description: Shown while the host classifies the open message.

panelTimedOut.message: MailMate is taking longer than usual.
panelTimedOut.description: Shown when classification exceeds the timeout.

panelClassifyFailed.description: Shown when classification returns an error.

panelNoMessage.message: Open a message to see what MailMate thinks of it.
panelNoMessage.description: Shown when no message is displayed.

panelHostUnreachable.message: MailMate host unreachable. Your mail is unaffected.
panelHostUnreachable.description: Shown when the native host is down.

dashApproveAllSafe.description: Review-card button: apply every safe suggested action at once.

dashDismiss.description: Review-card button: dismiss this card's suggestions.

dashExplain.description: Review-card button: show why MailMate made this call.

dashDismissed.description: Toast shown after a review card is dismissed.
